$comment: Single source of truth for the coordinated release. The npm packages all publish at `version` (sync mode — see RELEASING.md). The model identity (which trained artifact + tokenizer the neural-weights-* packages bundle) lives under `weights`, decoupled from the artifact's historical filename. Paths are relative to `weights.dataRoot` (override the root with MAILWOMAN_DATA_ROOT, or the individual files with MAILWOMAN_PUBLISH_MODEL / MAILWOMAN_PUBLISH_TOKENIZER). Bump `version` here in lockstep with the release; copy-weights.ts, the ship script, and the model card all read this instead of hardcoding the numbers.

weights.lineage: v3.23.0-bundle-guard — v3230 step-4000 (Option-A evidence bundle, the 5-run productionization arc v3.19→v3.23, 2026-07-28). init_from v385 on v385's own feed (v0.13.0-latam) + street_type[1] + locality_surface[2] evidence channels, absence curriculum + evidence-noise 0.15, four-law curated lexicons (street v3 / locality-surface v6) with rules.digit_guard — evidence never paints beside a digit. Fragment register (the bundle's purpose, inputMode=fragmented): admin-street-homonym +0.245 asis / +0.765 lower+heal (ON 0.948), bare-street +0.583 lower, particle +0.407, ALL +0.261; house-number classes protected by the guard (+0.013/+0.030 lower). Formatted register (channels off): v6.0.0-shipped-baseline PASS 17/17 (us.micro 87.1 vs shipped 86.8; fr.cedex 83.3 under the noise-honest 82.2 floor, NAMED WATCH — plateaued fine-tune forgetting, re-anchors at the next from-scratch retrain). Invariance zero new classes; gauntlet ×3; canary 20/20 formatted.

softFeed.$comment: Soft-feed artifacts (#718 D1) materialized into each neural-weights-<locale> workspace at publish time by copy-weights.ts so the library default `loadFromWeights` feeds the channels the anchor+gazetteer-trained model expects (closing the anchor-OFF crater). The PCB1 postcode binary is built from the WOF postcode shard (per locale's country code); the gazetteer lexicon is the codex-generated repo file. Paths under `db` are relative to weights.dataRoot/wof. Like the weights binaries, these are skipped in CI (MAILWOMAN_SKIP_WEIGHTS_COPY) — the publish workflow places them via the HF fetch step.

pairIndexByCountry.$comment: The placetype-pair-prior arc's PIX1 retrieval index (placetype-pair-prior arc, Task 3/8) — mirrors postcodeDBByCountry's shape exactly, but the source is a CSV of (child, parent) tuples rather than a WOF DB, and `--delta` is a REQUIRED calibrated value (no default — see `mailwoman gazetteer pair-index --help`). `source` is relative to weights.dataRoot (NOT weights.dataRoot/wof, unlike postcodeDBByCountry). COUNTRY-SPECIFIC BY DESIGN, same as the runtime resolver (neural/weights.ts's resolvePairIndexSibling): a locale with no entry here simply ships no pair-index sibling and the prior stays inert for it.

fr.$comment: Hierarchy campaign R6 (2026-08-01). Source is the raw BAN dump (DINUM/IGN, Licence Ouverte 2.0) read through ban/sdk's cleanLieuDit — NOT WOF, whose French neighbourhood records are Paris quartiers that never appear in a postal address. The line French addresses DO carry is the lieu-dit.

in.$comment: Hierarchy campaign R10 (2026-08-02). WOF-sourced (area, city) pairs with parent-alias expansion — India Post carries an area line on essentially every address, and WOF's city names lag official renames.

es.$comment: Hierarchy campaign R11 (2026-08-02). WOF-sourced pairs with parent-alias expansion; leading-postcode locale.

it.$comment: Hierarchy campaign R11 (2026-08-02). WOF-sourced pairs with parent-alias expansion; leading-postcode locale.

de.$comment: Hierarchy campaign R9 (2026-08-02). WOF-sourced (Ortsteil, Gemeinde) pairs — Deutsche Post routes 'PLZ Stadt' and carries no Ortsteil field, so there is no postal register to harvest.

us.$comment: Hierarchy campaign R5 (2026-08-01). No `source`: the US has no postal register carrying dependent localities (USPS routes city/state/ZIP), so every pair is WOF-sourced via --borough-db. Same delta/beta as GB — that is the pair the R5 bars were measured with.

assets.$comment: Where the model release lives for the demo + the CI weights pull. The release path embeds `version`; publish.yml derives the same path from the model card so CI and local stay in sync.
